result.method: exact binomial upper-tail test per head against the fleet median reject rate (0.00%), Bonferroni-corrected across 36 heads at sigma=3.0 (alpha=3.75e-05); cap-present closures only

result.denominator_explained: success_rate and reject_rate use cap-present closures (status 0 or 65) as the denominator; No Load cycles (status 2) are excluded because no cap was present to close. success_rate_all_cycles uses every cycle instead.
